title: Bates-stamp structural test vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of Bates-stamp candidates paired with structural rejection reasons. Mirrors the Swift ``detectBates`` regex at PIIDetector.swift:755 (pattern declared at :748-751).

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one Bates-stamp candidate with its expected structural verdict.

stamp.description: Bates-stamp candidate (prefix letters + optional separator + digits).

valid.description: Whether the candidate matches the Swift Bates regex shape.

rejection_reason.description: Which structural rule rejects this Bates stamp, or null if valid.
